title: Hearty Egyptian Chicken Broth
description: A spicy, silky broth that blends classic Egyptian spices with tender chicken, finished with miniature marshmallows for a kid-friendly twist. The dish is paleo-friendly and brine-wet for a deep umami flavor.
instructions: Place the chicken, onion, garlic, carrot, celery, cumin, coriander, paprika, turmeric, and cayenne in a large pot and cover with water.
Bring to a rolling boil over high heat, then reduce to a gentle simmer and cover.
Simmer for 45 minutes, or until the chicken is fully cooked and tender.
Remove the chicken, let it cool slightly, then shred the meat and return it to the pot.
Add a pinch of sea salt to taste and continue to simmer for 10 more minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Stir in the miniature marshmallows and let them soften, about 2 minutes, until they become silky and glossy.
Taste and adjust seasoning with additional salt or cayenne if desired.
Garnish with fresh cilantro if using and serve hot.
Let the broth cool before storing in airtight containers for up to 4 days in the refrigerator.
Reheat gently over low heat before serving again.
